paper.title: Scalable Video-to-Dataset Generation for Cross-Platform Mobile Agents
paper.central_claim: 提出 MONDAY：从 YouTube 教学视频自动提取移动 OS 导航数据（20K 视频/313K 标注帧，iOS+Android），含 OCR 场景切换检测(F1 95.04)、UI 元素检测(hit 99.87)、三步动作识别；将 MONDAY 纳入预训练的模型在未见平台(Windows Mobile)上平均提升 18.11 点，跨平台泛化更强。

provenance.session_receipt_note: worker has no session/receipt handle exposed; model name taken from system prompt
provenance.blind_boundary_note: No seat/aggregate/archive/old score read. research/patterns/assignments.jsonl was only grepped as a queue hint (truncated lines for 5 of 6 papers were displayed); its fit notes were not used as evidence and all pattern calls below were made from full text.

missing_sections: GPT-4o prompts not provided in text
reference paper read only by targeted grep for gap/lineage; not a full review

evidence.quote: manual annotation is time-consuming, rapid OS updates quickly make existing datasets obsolete, and they cover only a limited range of user configurations and real-world tasks.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者 gap：人工标注贵、OS 更新快、配置覆盖窄

evidence.quote: Video2Action relies on pixel-level differences, making it unreliable in diverse real-world settings.
evidence.support_explanation: 最近邻 Video2Action 的局限（作者归纳；该方法无代码，未能直接比较）

evidence.quote: requires pre-training on a human-labeled Android dataset
evidence.support_explanation: 最近邻 Chen et al. 的局限（同上）

evidence.quote: We first downloaded 129K videos and retained 20K after our filtering process.
evidence.support_explanation: 视频级过滤漏斗：129K→20K

evidence.quote: We only include Android or iOS mobile phones, as other mobile operating systems comprise less than 1% of the videos.
evidence.support_explanation: 覆盖收窄：只含 Android/iOS

evidence.quote: We calculate the Levenshtein distance [ 20 ] between corresponding text elements and mark a transition when the proportion of changed text exceeds 20% (we empirically set the threshold through our preliminary experiments).
evidence.support_explanation: OCR 场景切换：文本变化比例阈值 20%

evidence.quote: our action annotation process employs a novel three-step approach using GPT-4o [ 37 ] , incorporating video narration in each step to disambiguate actions in complex scenarios.
evidence.support_explanation: 三步动作识别，使用旁白

evidence.quote: analyzing the summaries of current and adjacent frames (two previous and two next), along with the SoM representation and narration.
evidence.support_explanation: 标注时使用前后各两帧与旁白——标注期特权信息，训练期策略看不到

evidence.quote: we manually annotated 100 YouTube videos, creating an evaluation dataset of 1,202 frames with 1,070 actions.
evidence.support_explanation: 管线评测集规模

evidence.quote: Using our scene transition detection output, annotators labeled actions between consecutive scenes using Label Studio with a custom interface.
evidence.support_explanation: 动作标注基于本管线的场景切分输出——动作准确率不独立于场景检测

evidence.quote: annotators marked them as ‘ambiguous’ and these were excluded from evaluation.
evidence.support_explanation: 歧义样本从评测中剔除

evidence.quote: achieving 95.04% F1-score compared to 82.27% and 70.86% for SceneDetect and YUV-diff, respectively.
evidence.support_explanation: 场景检测 F1

evidence.quote: Hit Ratio as our primary metric, which assesses whether any detected bounding box’s center point falls within the ground-truth interaction area
evidence.support_explanation: Hit Ratio 为“任一框命中”，宽松上界指标

evidence.quote: Multi-image 3-step ( Ours ) | 80.90 | 91.84
evidence.support_explanation: 动作识别总体/触控准确率
消融：一步式

evidence.quote: No narrations | 78.20 | 87.64
evidence.support_explanation: 消融：去旁白

evidence.quote: Workers found that 80.40% of 250 sampled actions were accurate
evidence.support_explanation: 训练集抽样人工复核：约 80% 准确（即约 20% 标签噪声未过滤）

evidence.quote: all models are further finetuned using LoRA on either the AitW or AMEX dataset for an equal number of epochs
evidence.support_explanation: 对照仅在下游微调轮数上对齐

evidence.quote: we restrict evaluation to actions common to all datasets.
evidence.support_explanation: 评测限于共同动作子集

evidence.quote: covering 78.51% of the AitW test set, 82.60% of the MONDAY test set and 94.39% of the Windows Mobile test set.
evidence.support_explanation: 子集覆盖率

evidence.quote: we manually annotated 50 videos containing 605 valid frames and 554 actions.
evidence.support_explanation: 未见平台 Windows Mobile 测试集规模（人工标注）
SeeClick(AitW 微调) 基线
SeeClick-MONDAY(AitW 微调)
Llama-3.2 基线
Llama-3.2-MONDAY
SeeClick(AMEX 微调) 基线：AMEX 列 68.19
同组 MONDAY 变体：AMEX 66.13 < 68.19（倒退）

evidence.quote: consistently outperforming models trained on existing single OS datasets while achieving an average performance gain of 18.11%p on an unseen mobile OS platform
evidence.support_explanation: 作者声称“一致更优/+18.11”
由 Table 5 四对 Windows Mobile 数值差 (13.17+12.20+23.41+23.17)/4 = 17.99，与 18.11 差 0.12（小幅不符，或来自未取整数值）；且“consistently”与 AMEX 倒退（M026/M027）不符

evidence.quote: The total cost for identifying actions for the 20,320 videos with GPT-4o was $6976, approximately $0.34 per video.
evidence.support_explanation: 总成本

evidence.quote: Scene transition and action annotation takes 12 minutes and costs $5.76 per video on average from an expert annotator.
evidence.support_explanation: 人工对照成本

evidence.quote: We will release our complete framework implementation upon acceptance to facilitate future research in mobile OS navigation.
evidence.support_explanation: 代码尚未释出

evidence.quote: After sampling the evaluation dataset, remove contaminated videos identified by an n-character overlap
evidence.support_explanation: 评测污染仅用标题 n-gram 去重

evidence.quote: AgentTrek [ 50 ] simulates actions in a virtual environment based on tutorial text, with step-by-step instructions from GPT-4o.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者对 AgentTrek 的仅附录一笔带过的描述

evidence.quote: employs a visual-language model (VLM) agent to execute these instructions in real environments, while a VLM-based evaluator verifies trajectory correctness.
evidence.support_explanation: 最近邻：AgentTrek 用真实环境回放+VLM 验证器校验轨迹（与 MONDAY 的“事后推断动作标签、无执行验证”形成对照）
全文含附录查找：GPT-4o 三步的完整提示词、标签置信度过滤、同规模 AitW/AMEX 额外数据对照、训练规模曲线、多种子/置信区间、在线 agent 评测——均未报告

evidence.quote: Our dataset primarily consists of iOS (49.50%) and Android (50.50%) platforms, including both physical devices and simulator recordings.
evidence.support_explanation: 数据平台构成

signatures.object: 视频级语料筛选（从网页问答→任务名→YouTube 视频）
signatures.information: C4/Dolma 网页帖标题；视频帧；转录文本
signatures.operation: GPT-3.5 抽取任务名→检索 129K 视频→GroundingDINO 手机屏幕检测→MediaPipe 手遮挡过滤→GPT-4o 判 OS/设备→场景数≤55
signatures.conditions: 英文转录、<15 分钟、仅 iOS/Android
signatures.selection_rule/data: 多级规则/模型过滤；评测视频按标题 30 字符重叠剔除
signatures.failure_boundary: 过滤使覆盖收窄（M004/M005）；去污仅标题级（M033）

signatures.object: 场景切换检测（基于 OCR 文本变化而非像素差）
signatures.information: 手机屏幕裁切后的帧(4FPS)，PaddleOCR 文本
signatures.operation: 同位置文本 Levenshtein 距离>20% 记为切换；置信度>0.9、忽略顶/底系统区、0.4s 合并
signatures.conditions: UI 含稳定文本；对暗色/OS 版本鲁棒
signatures.selection_rule/data: 阈值经初步实验设定（开发集未说明）
signatures.failure_boundary: 无文本变化的切换；动画

signatures.object: 动作识别（场景摘要→SoM+旁白+邻帧初判→缩放精修）
signatures.information: 当前及前后各两帧摘要、SoM 编号框、旁白（标注期可见未来帧与转录；训练期策略不可见）
signatures.operation: GPT-4o 三步产出触控/滚动/输入/硬件动作，坐标取框中心
signatures.output: (截图, 任务名, 动作) 序列用于 LoRA 微调
signatures.conditions: 依赖检测框命中；旁白消歧
signatures.selection_rule/data: 无标签置信度过滤；歧义样本仅在评测集剔除
signatures.later_use: SeeClick/Llama-3.2 额外 LoRA 阶段后再在 AitW/AMEX 微调
signatures.failure_boundary: 约 20% 标签噪声直接入训练（M017）；复杂手势、路径歧义

retention_trace.reason: 静态数据合成/预训练组件，不声称自我改进或留存。

gap.author_gap: 移动导航训练数据靠人工标注/模拟器，成本高、迅速过时、配置覆盖窄且缺 iOS（M001）。
gap.checked_gap: 缺口真实：AitW/AMEX 为 Android 模拟器/众包；视频挖掘的近邻 Video2Action 与 Chen et al. 无代码（M002/M003），作者因此只能做自身消融；固定最近邻 AgentTrek（2412.09605）走“教程文本→真实环境回放→VLM 验证”的另一条低成本路线，正文未比较，仅附录一笔带过（M034/M035）。

lineage.closest_adjacent: AgentTrek (2412.09605, Dec 2024 版本): 教程→回放→VLM 评估器；MONDAY 不执行、仅推断动作标签。

gap.residue: 视频标签质量（约 80%）与“离线动作匹配”之外是否能提升在线任务成功未知。
gap.stakes: 标签噪声直接入训练；离线指标可能高估在线收益（E15）。
gap.method_response: OCR 场景切换+SoM 检测+带旁白/邻帧/缩放的三步动作识别，成本 $0.34/视频（M030/M031）。
gap.remaining_gap: 在线任务成功率；标签噪声过滤；与 AgentTrek 类低成本数据的同预算对比；Web/桌面扩展。
unresolved: Video2Action/Chen et al. 无法并行复现，其局限为作者陈述。

G.reason: 缺口具体（人工标注贵、过时、iOS 缺失、真实配置多样性，M001）且有最近邻与祖先（Video2Action、Chen et al.、AitW/AMEX）。扣分：近邻无代码、未比较；固定最近邻 AgentTrek 走“回放+VLM 验证”的另一路线，正文未讨论（M034/M035）；缺口“真实多样性提升泛化”只在离线上被检验。介于 2 与 4。

M.reason: 设计与问题对位清楚：OCR 文本比像素更跨 OS/暗色稳定（M006、M012）；SoM+检测框降低 VLM 空间定位误差；旁白+邻帧+缩放精修用于消歧（M007/M008，消融 M015/M016 支持）。弱点：标注期使用未来帧与旁白但训练期不可见，标签噪声约 20% 未处理；未说明为何离线动作匹配能代表在线能力。逻辑可检验但假设未全验证。=3。

X.reason: 链条可重建：过滤漏斗数字（M004）、OCR 阈值与细节（附录 C.1/C.2）、训练超参（附录 G）与动作空间统一（G.2）均给出。扣分：GPT-4o 三步提示词未提供（M036）、代码待发布（M032）、无标签置信度过滤/重试规则、阈值设定过程不明。=3。

E.measurement.reason: 管线指标有独立双人标注+第三人裁决（M009），分母清楚，且有对照基线；但动作标注以本管线场景切分为底（M010），Hit Ratio 是“任一框命中”的宽松上界（M013），歧义样本被剔除（M011）；下游为离线精确动作匹配，限于共同动作子集（M019/M020）。无在线成功率。=2。

E.causality.reason: 管线内部消融扎实（M014-M016）；但下游增益仅比较“有/无 MONDAY 额外 LoRA 阶段”，没有等量 AitW/AMEX/其他数据的对照、没有 iOS-only/Android-only 消融来支持“多平台多样性”解释（M018/M036）；去标签噪声版本未对照。替代解释（额外数据量/额外训练）未排除。=1。

E.holdout.reason: Windows Mobile 作为未见平台是真正的平台留出，且由人工标注、与管线标签来源独立（M021）；AitW/AMEX 为标准测试集。扣分：仅离线；去污仅用标题 30 字符重叠（M033）；MONDAY 测试集与训练同分布；主张“跨平台泛化”在线上无证据。=2。

E.statistics.reason: 给出测试规模（554 动作、1,070 动作、250 复核样本）与标注者分歧率；但所有下游结果单次、无种子/置信区间；摘要均值与表不符 0.12（M029）；AMEX 列倒退 2.06（M027）未讨论；无失败原因分层（仅 Appendix I 示例）。=1。

E.cost.reason: 明确报告总成本与单视频成本、人工对照成本、处理时间（附录 A.2）；成本—质量折算缺失（标签 80%），训练算力仅给轮数。=3。

readable_rationale: MONDAY 是扎实的“视频→移动导航数据”工程：管线各模块有人工留出验证、成本清楚、并有一个真正的未见平台测试。但全部下游证据为离线动作匹配；增益与“多一个 313K 帧的训练阶段”混杂，无等量数据对照；标签约 20% 噪声直接入训练；摘要 18.11 与表内 17.99 小幅不符，AMEX 有倒退。故 claim_support=scoped，原始分 62.5（未校准草案）。
